source_record.english: The answer is that there is no occurrence of this stage for such a person. In the first place, the stage cannot occur before the victim dies; in the second place, where the murderer dies at the same time as his victim, another body of the killer has been born. There is no actual commission because the body never went through the stage of undertaking this act towards the victim in question.
